nodes.name: CacheUtil.java
nodes.summary: In-memory TTL cache utility backed by a ConcurrentHashMap with a scheduled refresh task and shutdown hook, used as the default local captcha cache.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses ScheduledThreadPoolExecutor with CallerRunsPolicy for periodic expiry checks.

nodes.name: ImageUtils.java
nodes.summary: Loads and caches captcha template images (jigsaw, click-word, rotate) from classpath or filesystem and converts images to/from Base64 strings.

nodes.name: JsonUtil.java
nodes.summary: Minimal reflection-based JSON serialization helpers for PointVO-style objects used by the captcha coordinate payload.
nodes.languageNotes: Custom lightweight JSON handling instead of Jackson/Fastjson to keep the base captcha module dependency-free.

nodes.name: Md5Util.java
nodes.summary: MD5 hashing helper with optional salt, used to derive captcha verification keys.

nodes.name: RandomUtils.java
nodes.summary: Random value generators (UUID, random Chinese characters, bounded ints, random strings) supporting captcha content generation.

nodes.name: StringUtils.java
nodes.summary: Self-contained Apache Commons Lang-style string utility (empty/blank checks, strip, indexOf, substring family) vendored into the captcha module to avoid external dependencies.
nodes.languageNotes: Vendored copy of Apache Commons Lang StringUtils (~1700 lines) so the base captcha library stays dependency-free.

nodes.name: AjCaptchaAutoConfiguration.java
nodes.summary: Spring Boot auto-configuration entry that enables AjCaptchaProperties configuration properties binding.

nodes.name: AjCaptchaServiceAutoConfiguration.java
nodes.summary: Auto-configuration that builds the CaptchaService bean from AjCaptchaProperties, maps every property into the captcha config, and preloads template images.

nodes.name: AjCaptchaStorageAutoConfiguration.java
nodes.summary: Auto-configuration exposing the CaptchaCacheService bean resolved from CaptchaServiceFactory by configured cache type.

nodes.name: CaptchaAutoConfig.java
nodes.summary: Damai-specific captcha configuration wiring CaptchaHandle and a Redis-backed CaptchaCacheService with the application's StringRedisTemplate.

nodes.name: CaptchaController.java
nodes.summary: REST controller exposing captcha get/check endpoints, enriching requests with client browser/IP information before delegating to CaptchaService.

nodes.name: AjCaptchaProperties.java
nodes.summary: Configuration properties POJO (prefix aj.captcha) covering captcha type, images, watermark, fonts, AES, cache settings, and request frequency limits.

nodes.name: CaptchaCacheServiceRedisImpl.java
nodes.summary: Redis-backed implementation of CaptchaCacheService using StringRedisTemplate for set/get/exists/delete/increment captcha cache operations.

nodes.name: CaptchaHandle.java
nodes.summary: Component wrapper around CaptchaService that enriches captcha requests with browser info and remote client ID from the current HTTP request context.

nodes.name: RemoteUtil.java
nodes.summary: Shared utility resolving the real client IP from X-Forwarded-For / Proxy-Client-IP headers or the remote address.

nodes.name: CheckNeedCaptchaDataVo.java
nodes.summary: Client-facing VO carrying the captcha requirement flag and generated captcha id returned by the user service.

nodes.name: UserCaptchaController.java
nodes.summary: User-service REST controller exposing endpoints to check whether captcha is required, fetch a captcha, and verify a captcha answer.

nodes.name: UserCaptchaService.java
nodes.summary: User-service captcha logic: decides via a Lua-scripted Redis counter whether verification is required, issues captcha ids from UidGenerator, and delegates get/verify to CaptchaHandle.

nodes.name: CacheUtil
nodes.summary: Static in-memory cache with per-entry expiry timestamps, capacity cap, scheduled refresh, and JVM shutdown cleanup.

nodes.name: ImageUtils
nodes.summary: Static image cache/registry for captcha templates offering random image selection and Base64 conversion helpers.

nodes.name: JsonUtil
nodes.summary: Lightweight JSON parse/serialize helper using reflection and object-provided toJsonString/parse hooks.

nodes.name: Md5Util
nodes.summary: MD5 digest utility producing lowercase hex strings, with a salted variant.

nodes.name: RandomUtils
nodes.summary: Collection of random generators including GBK-encoded random Chinese character production for click-word captchas.

nodes.name: StringUtils
nodes.summary: Vendored Apache Commons Lang-style null-safe string manipulation library used throughout the captcha module.

nodes.name: AjCaptchaAutoConfiguration
nodes.summary: Configuration class enabling AjCaptchaProperties via @EnableConfigurationProperties.

nodes.name: AjCaptchaServiceAutoConfiguration
nodes.summary: Builds the CaptchaService bean, transferring all AjCaptchaProperties into the runtime config and initializing image base maps.

nodes.name: AjCaptchaStorageAutoConfiguration
nodes.summary: Provides the CaptchaCacheService bean by looking up the configured cache type in CaptchaServiceFactory.

nodes.name: CaptchaAutoConfig
nodes.summary: Wires CaptchaHandle and injects the application StringRedisTemplate into the Redis captcha cache implementation.

nodes.name: CaptchaController
nodes.summary: REST controller for captcha get/check operations with client IP resolution from forwarding headers.

nodes.name: AjCaptchaProperties
nodes.summary: Configuration properties holder for all aj.captcha settings including frequency limits and cache type.

nodes.name: CaptchaCacheServiceRedisImpl
nodes.summary: CaptchaCacheService implementation storing captcha state in Redis via StringRedisTemplate.

nodes.name: CaptchaHandle
nodes.summary: Facade combining HTTP request context enrichment with CaptchaService get/check/verification calls.

nodes.name: RemoteUtil
nodes.summary: Static helper extracting the originating client IP from proxy headers.

nodes.name: CheckNeedCaptchaDataVo
nodes.summary: Simple VO with verifyCaptcha flag and captchaId fields returned to clients.

nodes.name: UserCaptchaController
nodes.summary: REST controller delegating captcha requirement checks and get/verify operations to UserCaptchaService.

nodes.name: UserCaptchaService
nodes.summary: Service deciding captcha necessity through a Redis Lua counter and delegating captcha generation/verification to CaptchaHandle.

nodes.name: init
nodes.summary: Initializes cache capacity/expiry, starts the scheduled refresh executor with a daemon thread factory, and registers a shutdown hook.

nodes.name: set
nodes.summary: Stores a value with an expiry timestamp, clearing the cache when the capacity threshold is exceeded.

nodes.name: exists
nodes.summary: Checks key presence and lazily deletes entries whose expiry timestamp has passed.

nodes.name: cacheImage
nodes.summary: Loads jigsaw, click-word, and rotate template images from classpath or custom filesystem paths into the static cache maps and records filename arrays per captcha type.

nodes.name: getImageToBase64Str
nodes.summary: Encodes a BufferedImage to a PNG Base64 string via ImageIO.

nodes.name: getBase64StrToImage
nodes.summary: Decodes a Base64 string back into a BufferedImage.

nodes.name: getResourcesImagesFile
nodes.summary: Reads a fixed sequence of numbered images from a classpath directory into a Base64-keyed map.

nodes.name: getImagesFile
nodes.summary: Scans a filesystem directory and loads every file as a Base64-encoded image map entry.

nodes.name: parseArray
nodes.summary: Splits a JSON array literal into elements and parses each into the target type.

nodes.name: parseObject
nodes.summary: Instantiates the target class reflectively and populates it by invoking its parse hook with the JSON text.

nodes.name: toJsonString
nodes.summary: Serializes supported objects (PointVO, lists, maps) to JSON text, rejecting unsupported types.

nodes.name: md5
nodes.summary: Computes the lowercase hex MD5 digest of the input string.

nodes.name: getRandomHan
nodes.summary: Generates a random simplified Chinese character by assembling GBK high/low byte codes.
nodes.languageNotes: Builds characters from the GBK encoding range (0xB0-0xF7 high byte, 0xA1-0xFE low byte).

nodes.name: isBlank
nodes.summary: Returns true when the string is null, empty, all whitespace, or the literal string "null".

nodes.name: stripStart
nodes.summary: Strips leading whitespace or specified characters from the start of a string.

nodes.name: stripEnd
nodes.summary: Strips trailing whitespace or specified characters from the end of a string.

nodes.name: ordinalIndexOf
nodes.summary: Finds the n-th occurrence index of a substring, supporting forward and backward search.

nodes.name: indexOfAny
nodes.summary: Returns the earliest index at which any of the given search strings occurs.

nodes.name: substring
nodes.summary: Null-safe substring with negative index handling measured from the end of the string.

nodes.name: substringBetween
nodes.summary: Extracts the substring between the first occurrences of an open and close tag.

nodes.name: captchaService
nodes.summary: Bean factory method translating every AjCaptchaProperties value into the captcha runtime Properties, initializing image base maps, and returning the CaptchaService instance.

nodes.name: getResourcesImagesFile
nodes.summary: Resolves classpath image resources via PathMatchingResourcePatternResolver and encodes them as Base64 map entries.

nodes.name: captchaCacheService
nodes.summary: Creates the CaptchaCacheService bean from the factory and injects the shared StringRedisTemplate when the Redis implementation is selected.

nodes.name: checkNeedCaptcha
nodes.summary: Generates a captcha id via UidGenerator, builds counter/timestamp/captcha-id Redis keys, and runs the CheckNeedCaptchaOperate Lua script to decide whether verification is required.
